The interpatch distance a grid can represent

Source: R/resolve-buffer.R
representable_distance.Rd

Buffering grows habitat a whole cell at a time, by half the interpatch distance from each side, so a distance is rounded down to a multiple of twice the cell size. Below twice the cell size nothing is buffered, and only patches that touch are joined. habitat_connectivity() warns when either happens; this says which distance you get, before you run anything.

Usage

representable_distance(interpatch_distance, resolution)

Arguments

interpatch_distance

Numeric vector of distances, in metres.

resolution

Cell size in metres, a single positive number.

Value

A numeric vector the length of interpatch_distance: the distance each is treated as. 0 where it can't be represented, which includes a negative distance. NA stays NA.

See also

vignette("interpatch-distance-and-resolution")

Examples

representable_distance(c(100, 250, 15), resolution = 10)
#> [1] 100 240   0
